In the transcript excerpt, he does not say how many tokens were input, output or cache tokens, and he does not name the model or speed tier. Without those details, his use cannot be priced at Anthropic list prices. A personal blog dated 2026-04-21 (e2) said he used 7.7B tokens in March and April, "mostly Opus 4.6," and put the cost at "$150,000+" for the two months. The blog does not cite a source, say how it priced the tokens, or give a token split. So it cannot confirm or rule out the claim. No evidence item gives a dollar value for his monthly use from Cherny, Anthropic or reputable reporting. The evidence neither confirms nor rules out 'upwards of $130,000 a month'.
limitations: The transcript is dated only to June 2026, and 'since March' does not give an exact start date.
